description: Databases written by earlier schema versions, opened by the current reference: a 1.x database (legacy-messages.db, messages keyed by id alone) and a 2.x database built inline. Expected results are what the reference returns after the open migrates the file.

cases.name: a 1.x database keeps every message, in order, with its attachments
a 1.x database answers search for its old messages
a 1.x database takes new chats that reuse its message ids
a 1.x database gains the newer columns and the default workspace
a 1.x database gains the statistics table without losing chats
a 2.x database opens unchanged and adopts its chats into the default workspace
a schema version written as hex text reads as its number, so no migration runs
